annotations.title: Ask the human to store a secret

description: Ask the flow's owner to enter a third-party credential (API key, auth token, webhook secret) into Final's encrypted vault. THIS TOOL TAKES NO VALUE and no tool ever returns one — the human types it into a masked input in the Miami builder, and it goes straight into the vault. Why: flow builds are DISTRIBUTABLE to other companies, so a credential must never be baked into the code (validate_flow and deploy_flow scan for and block hardcoded secrets). Your generated code reads it at RUNTIME with renderClient.getSecretVal({ key }) and must degrade gracefully while the key isn't stored yet (disable the integration + tell the user to configure it — never crash). After calling this: tell YOUR user to open the builder link and enter the value, and poll list_secret_keys to detect when it lands.
